_doc: One business's settings for the partners, collaborators and influencers function. Names of things only: no key, no inbox password, no contact list, no partner name. Every value here is a default a business can change.
offer: a free listing in a directory where businesses find each other for collaborations, partnerships, sponsorships, deals and commission referral campaigns
buyer: business owners who want a partner: someone to collaborate with, sponsor or be sponsored by, do a deal with, or swap referral campaigns with

volume._doc: The owner's numbers (2026-11-16): 1,000 a day, 10 per inbox. sends_per_day counts follow-ups. partners.py plan works out the inboxes and the new names a day this needs.

sequence._doc: Day 0 is the first email. The follow-ups are a default, not something the owner asked for.

sender._doc: tool is the name of the sending tool, as the owner calls it. Kept for the owner's call (STATUS.md, list item 4): sending inboxes are not mailboxes anyone uses for real mail.
sender.inbox_set: the name of this function's inbox group in the sending tool
sender.reply_to: the sales agent's inbox for this function

dream_lists._doc: Where the two dream lists live in the bot's workspace. Each is a csv with any of: email, domain, link, name. Someone on either list has been identified as Dream 100 or Dream 500, so is not in this tier.

types._doc: All types are in. A type picks the email a person gets; it does not rank anyone, and a row whose type is not listed here is still kept. pathway is one sentence for a type where the path from their audience to the offer is obvious; empty means the email names no offer. hand_to passes a type to another function.

newsletter.who: people who write to a list our buyers read

community.who: owners of groups and communities our buyers are in
promotion: a talk in front of their group

creator.who: creators and influencers our buyers follow, any size

consultant-coach.who: consultants and coaches whose clients are our buyers
promotion: a talk in front of their group

agency-software.who: agencies and software firms that serve our buyers

local-business.who: offline businesses whose customers are our buyers, such as a trades company

affiliate.who: people who already promote other people's offers to our buyers

show.who: podcast and interview show hosts: they stay with SpeakerAgent

promotion_counts_as: a talk in front of their group
anything else that promotes the business

monthly_goal._doc: The owner: 'a couple of these per month'.

hand_off.replies: the sales agent's inbox for this function
hand_off.owner: an interested partner, with the thread: what the partner gets is custom
hand_off.speaker: show hosts found while building lists
